note: Excluded non-tree outcomes (Glyceria, Onoclea, Alliaria, crops), nutrient/allocation/SLA/survival/regeneration outcomes. Cover crops treated as competing vegetation; e22 (lime + cover crop) is a compound cause. Removal/suppression edges sign-flipped.

Many edges contrast one amendment type against another (subsoil Bm/BC/C, topsoil vs compost) rather than against no amendment; signed as the sentence states. e26/e46 nodes say Bm&C decreased aspen growth but sentences say BC was lower, so signed +1. Excluded soil moisture, OM depth, scarification, forest-floor mixing, foliar nutrients, and grass/forb/crop outcomes.
Only candidates are winter road clearances (vehicle-road linear disturbance), judged not an instance of trampling & recreation. If winter roads count, e1 would be a null result (effect 0, low).

Kept only outcomes the text ties to native species. Excluded generic plant density/cover edges from rec.12106 (native status not stated), smoke/ash fire-cue treatments, non-native cover, richness/diversity, and pussytoes/bluegrass (native status not stated).

e4/e13 signs come from species loading on an ordination axis tied to time since restoration. Excluded tree/conifer regeneration densities (native status not stated), composition/similarity, richness/diversity, non-native outcomes, and 'time passage' edges with no stated disturbance.

Excluded soil supply rates, liming soil chemistry, pore water, foliar biomass, TNC, RSR, 15N allocation/recovery. e16 signed -1 per sentence (stem K higher at lower rate). Some edges compare fertilizer regimes (exponential vs constant, F1 vs F2), signed as stated.
Engineered-structure edges concern macroinvertebrates, epilithon and CPOM in streams, not soil microbes; biochar edges are not in-stream/engineered structures.

Included grass and Iris seedling survivorship and shrub cutting survival as seedling survival; aspen leaf-litter cover treated as surface cover. Excluded hydroseeded cover, cover crops, seedbed mats, surface roughness, and density/establishment/growth outcomes.

Included cover soils, biochar/coke (OTU richness), substrate amendments; many are type-vs-type contrasts. Excluded smoke/ash fire cues, microaspect, surface disturbance, FPOM in streams, Shannon diversity/evenness-only outcomes, and PK substrate edges e39/e48.

No candidate has a temperature/microclimate cause with a composition outcome; nurse-plant edges have temperature as the outcome, and e59 (soil moisture vs ordination axis) is hydrology, not microclimate.
